evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies block serving logic in `src/net_processing.cpp` for `MSG_BLOCK` requests.
rationale: Optimizes serving non-witness `MSG_BLOCK` requests by stripping witnesses in-place from serialized buffers, achieving an 8.9x–9.3x speedup and reducing heap allocations in benchmarks. While legacy `MSG_BLOCK` traffic is currently minor, this mitigates resource overhead when serving blocks and unblocks proposed witnessless IBD (#36476).
